name: LT1057 / LT1058 (Linear Technology dual/quad JFET-input precision high-speed op-amp)
tagline: Linear Tech's matched-JFET precision dual and quad. Chinese and Korean op-amp rollers call it cold, fast and highly resolving, especially the gold TO-5 can.
technology: Matched JFET-input precision op-amp. The LT1057 is a dual in the industry-standard 8-pin pinout. The LT1058 is a quad in the standard 14-pin pinout, and its datasheet calls it the lowest-offset quad JFET op-amp in that pinout. Datasheet headline figures: 14 V/us slew (10 V/us min), 5 MHz GBW, 1.3 us settling to 0.02%, 13 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz, and 50 pA bias current at 70 C. CN hobby sources quote about 60 pA bias. The draft's claim that it is positioned as an LF412A/OP-215 upgrade was not confirmed in this pass.

part_numbers.notes: Dual, industry-standard 8-pin pinout. Offered in plastic PDIP and SO packages according to the ADI page and datasheet.
As listed in the Baidu Tieba roundup. The LTC suffix for 8-pin PDIP is normally N8, so this is probably the A-grade LT1057ACN8. Exact order code unconfirmed.
C-grade 8-pin plastic DIP. PDIP availability is confirmed; this exact order code was not seen in the search summaries.
SO-8, -40 C to 85 C (I grade). Confirmed by a radiolocman datasheet listing and the datasheet temperature table.
The 'gold can' version prized by HIFIDIY users (LTC H package). Ordering codes such as LT1057ACH, LT1057CH and LT1057AMH, and their status, were not confirmed. Likely old or NOS stock only.
Quad, standard 14-pin pinout. Datasheet figures: 180 uV typ and 600 uV max offset.
14-pin plastic DIP. Confirmed by a radiolocman datasheet listing.
0 C to 70 C grade named in the datasheet temperature table next to LT1058AC and LT1058C. Presumably the surface-mount (wide SO) version, but the package was not confirmed.

lineage.notes: Original LTC datasheet code 10578f*. The intro year was not confirmed in this pass.
Datasheet rehosted as analog.com .../10578fd.pdf. Product pages lt1057.html and lt1058.html are live.

key_specs.value: LT1057: 150 uV typ / 450 uV max; LT1058: 180 uV typ / 600 uV max
13 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz; 26 nV/rtHz at 10 Hz

reputation.summary: Praise comes mainly from Chinese and Korean op-amp-rolling communities. The Baidu Tieba '40款音频运算放大器主观分析评价' roundup credits the LT1057ACN with good extension at both ends, speed and dynamics, but a cool tone and a slightly recessed midrange. HIFIDIY users describe the gold-can LT1057 as extended, fast, dynamic and resolving but 'cold' in colour, and roll it next to the OPA2111HK. An EET-China blog puts it in the 'cold and elegant' (冷艳) class. The Korean digipine summary repeats this, and the car-audio shop sounting.com lists it as a 'fever' (烧级) op-amp. These are subjective forum opinions and were not re-verified in this pass.
typical_uses: op-amp rolling in DAC I/V and output stages (DIY)
headphone amplifier and preamp socket upgrades
caveats: Praise is regional (CN/KR forums) and subjective, with no Western-forum consensus found.
The 'cold' voicing may not suit systems that are already bright.
The metal-can versions sought by rollers are old or NOS stock, which carries a counterfeit and remark risk.
JFET-input bias current rises with temperature (datasheet specifies 50 pA at 70 C).

Current revision. The change log was not visible in the search summaries. Revisions A and C presumably exist but were not found.

counterfeit_notes: No LT1057-specific counterfeit reports were found in this pass. The metal-can (TO-5) and early DIP LT1057/LT1058 that rollers seek are now old or NOS stock, sold largely through Taobao, eBay and secondary brokers. Treat unusually cheap 'gold can' LT1057s with the usual suspicion of remarked parts, and check marking style, date codes and DC parameters (offset voltage, bias current) against the datasheet.
alternatives: OPA2111 (metal-can JFET dual that HIFIDIY users roll next to the LT1057)
LF412A / OP-215 (older JFET duals the LT1057 is said to upgrade; this positioning is unconfirmed)
open_questions: What are the print dates and change logs for rev D (10578fd) and rev B (10578fb), and do rev A, rev C or an original 10578f copy survive on any mirror?
What is the current ADI lifecycle status (Production, NRND or Obsolete) of each LT1057/LT1058 order code? Were the H (TO-5) and CerDIP versions and the A-grades discontinued, and under which PDN?
Did any die, fab or assembly change (LTC fab consolidation, ADI integration) affect LT1057/LT1058? None was found.
Is ADI PCN 22_0172 relevant? It appeared in one search's results, but its content and any link to LT1057/LT1058 are unknown.
When was the LT1057/LT1058 introduced, and which revision first added the SO packages and the I grade?
Does the datasheet itself position the part as an upgrade for LF412A and OP-215 (draft claim)?

corrections: Set channel counts: LT1057 = 2, LT1058 = 4 (the draft had 0).
The draft said 60 pA bias current. The datasheet headline is 50 pA at 70 C, so 60 pA is kept only as a CN-source figure.
Added confirmed part numbers LT1057IS8 (#PBF) and LT1058CN (#PBF), plus the LT1058S grade from the datasheet temperature table.
Flagged 'LT1057ACN' as a probable shorthand for the LT1057ACN8 order code (unconfirmed).
Added the current datasheet (rev D, 10578fd) and the legacy LTC CDN copy, plus rev B (10578fb) mirrors at Marutsu, Farnell and Futurlec.
Added key_specs from the datasheet headline (slew, GBW, settling, Vos, Ib, noise).
Downgraded the 'drop-in upgrade for LF412A/OP-215' claim to unconfirmed.
claims_confirmed: The current ADI datasheet is 10578fd (rev D), titled 'LT1057/LT1058 - Dual and Quad, JFET Input Precision High Speed Op Amps': https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
A legacy LTC CDN copy of rev D exists: https://cds.linear.com/docs/en/datasheet/10578fd.pdf
The Marutsu copy holds rev B (10578fb): https://www.marutsu.co.jp/contents/shop/marutsu/datasheet/LT1057.pdf
The Farnell copy holds rev B (10578fb): https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/514478.pdf
The Futurlec copy shows 10578fb in its title: https://www.futurlec.com/Datasheet/Linear/LT1058.pdf
Datasheet headline: 14 V/us slew (10 V/us min), 5 MHz GBW, 1.3 us settling to 0.02%: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf

Offset voltage is 150 uV typ / 450 uV max for LT1057 and 180 uV typ / 600 uV max for LT1058; bias current is 50 pA at 70 C: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
Noise is 13 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz and 26 nV/rtHz at 10 Hz: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
LT1057 is a matched JFET dual in the industry-standard 8-pin pinout; LT1058 is the lowest-offset quad JFET op-amp in the standard 14-pin pinout: https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/514478.pdf
The LT1057IS8#PBF order code exists (-40 C to 85 C): https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/data.html?di=337791
ADI product pages exist for both parts: https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1057.html and https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1058.html
